Ignore local backup certificates and scratch certify logs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Tidy the repository and add matched existence without the classification

- Untrack archive/ and research/ (preserved at tag archive-2026-10-11; kept on disk); fold openai/ into proof/LITERATURE.md
- Distil the coverage returns: drop duplicated inputs and superseded Lean copies; Step 1 certificates live once in lean/Step1Gen; C renamed C_step1_saddle
- New returns E_matched_flatness and F_side_existence (both replayed): matched existence (L1) proved by exact certificates, without [CT]; added to verify.py
- Atlas: geometry.py replaces volume.py/conditioning.py/lib (bit-identical helpers); record.py reduced to the live frame code (no archive import); build logs grouped; receipt updated
- Independent checker: vendored Julia env, results_v3 = fresh full run, v2 failures kept as one TSV
- Lean: MainTheorem proves both main theorems directly (Final.lean variants removed); Step1Saddle -> Step1/Saddle; README rewritten, ROADMAP folded in
- README, PROOF, AUDIT and folder READMEs rewritten for the new layout and status

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

-# Lean source snapshot — 8 October 2026
-
-This archive preserves **19,386 distinct Lean source files (273,077,698 bytes)** from the no-four-MUB research program and classification pipeline. It maps **77,948 workspace paths**, and separately preserves all **1,116 Lean paths** at prior publication commit `ed8470c7d77e76121610492b3bed98b98a5f1b3b`.
-
-**This is a source archive, not a completed no-four-MUB proof or a new Lean admission.** No compiler was run during collection. Historical drafts, unsuccessful experiments, probes, generated modules, and successful compile-source copies coexist. Every path is explicitly marked archival; a historical receipt does not confer new proof credit.
-
-There are **17,052 unavailable cloud-only workspace paths**. Their names and sizes are retained; their bytes were not read or hydrated. 94 paths were reconstructed from an exact historical path/hash pin and identical resident bytes. Such reconstruction preserves the pinned historical version; it does not inspect or certify the current cloud placeholder. Canonical historical source gaps remain real and are not all asserted to be duplicate compile copies. See `GAP_REPORT.json` before describing completeness.
-
-## Verify and restore
-
-Requires Python 3.9 or later, with only its standard library. These commands are offline and do not invoke Lean, Git, downloads, or package installation:
-
-```sh
-python3 verify_restore.py
-python3 verify_restore.py --restore /path/to/empty/restored-workspace --dry-run
-python3 verify_restore.py --restore /path/to/empty/restored-workspace
-python3 verify_restore.py --restore /path/to/empty/restored-workspace --include-prior-git
-```
-
-The restorer preserves each original workspace-relative source path, skips unavailable bytes, and refuses to overwrite differing files. `--prefix research_factory/classification_extensions/` selects a subtree. `--require-complete` fails when the selected subtree has missing bytes. Prior Git sources restore under `prior-publication/<commit>/`, keeping that historical layout separate from workspace paths.
-
-## Contents and scope
-
-- `SOURCE_INDEX.jsonl`: every discovered workspace Lean path, source availability, SHA256 and blob mapping.
-- `BLOB_INDEX.jsonl` and `blobs/<prefix>/<sha256>/<filename>.lean`: one exact-byte copy per SHA256, retaining a Lean filename.
-- `GIT_SOURCE_INDEX.jsonl`: all prior published Lean paths with Git blob IDs and SHA256 bindings.
-- `SOURCE_RECOVERY.json`: exact path/hash evidence for recovered placeholders. Older `json_location_breadcrumb` values are human-readable locations, not RFC6901 pointers.
-- `IMPORT_INDEX.json`: heuristic import-name candidates across historical versions; ambiguity is explicit. It is not a context-resolved build graph.
-- `GAP_REPORT.json`: missing-path groups, unresolved historical import names, and exact-source checks against prior published inventories.
-- `provenance/`: selected mathematical source, review, status, dependency and replay records from portable Lean packets. Their original claims retain their original limited scope; no arbitrary cluster logs or access files are included.
-- `SUMMARY.json`: exact roots, exclusions, counts and admission limitations. `FILE_MANIFEST.json` binds the final archive files.
-
-The bounded source roots include `mub6-numerical` prerequisites, evidence, importer, worker sources and runs; the classification-cover port; `research_factory/lean`; the interval/graph kernels and formal core; and `research_factory/classification_extensions`. No whole-project inventory was attempted. Compiler, mathlib/vendor trees, build/cache directories and the publication checkout were excluded from the workspace traversal. These are directory-policy exclusions, not a claim that every omitted authored byte was proved redundant.
-
-## Dependencies, replay and licensing
-
-Sources span historical Lean versions. Prior portable packets retain their `lean-toolchain`, mathlib revision/dependency manifests, source inventories and serial replay plans where published. The modern classification/physical packets use Lean `v4.33.0-rc2` and mathlib commit `51e6992efd06126df61a496bebf8f49482a4e129`; older source versions may require their own pinned environment. `LICENSE.mathlib` is reused for upstream material and does not assign a new license to authored research sources.
-
-There is deliberately no universal `lake build`: modules with the same name have different historical source hashes, and many snapshots lack an exact selected import/object binding. Use a selected portable packet's inventory and replay order, preserving its source/cache authenticity caveat. The archive carries source only: no `.olean`, `.ilean`, compiler binaries or large numerical datasets.
-
-Formal admission still requires guarded kernel checking, exact source/object/import/receipt pins, an explicit axiom audit, and independent statement/hypothesis review. Allowed standard axioms are `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`; sorry, custom research axioms and native decision shortcuts do not receive proof credit. Generated proof replay must preserve the trust-level and kernel-check restrictions. Local compilation, if later authorized, remains serialized through the unchanged resource guard (180 seconds/job, 2304 MiB heap, 2816 MiB RSS, 2 GiB free disk, `-j1`). This snapshot closes no physical sector; closure requires complete, correctly scoped Lean obligations to be admitted.

-def momentP (s t r : ℂ) : ℝ :=
-  Complex.normSq s + Complex.normSq t + Complex.normSq r
-
-def momentJ (s t r : ℂ) : ℝ := 2 * (r*s*star t).re

-  Complex.normSq s * Complex.normSq t +
-  Complex.normSq s * Complex.normSq r +
-  Complex.normSq t * Complex.normSq r -
-  Complex.normSq s * Complex.normSq t * Complex.normSq r

-  exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (Complex.normSq_nonneg s) (Complex.normSq_nonneg t))

-  simp [momentP]

-theorem momentJ_neg (s t r : ℂ) : momentJ (-s) (-t) (-r) = -momentJ s t r := by

-    CriticalScalarReduction20261003.R (momentP s t r) (momentJ s t r) (momentW s t r) =
-      FourierRadicalGuards.radicand (FourierGramNumerators.g s t r)
-        (FourierGramNumerators.chi s t r) (FourierGramNumerators.eta s t r) := by
-  simp [CriticalScalarReduction20261003.R, FourierRadicalGuards.radicand,
-    FourierGramNumerators.g, FourierGramNumerators.chi, FourierGramNumerators.eta,
-    FourierGramNumerators.sigma, FourierGramNumerators.q, momentP, momentJ, momentW]

-    norm_num [CubeCertificate,rootResidual,crossingBox,boxNormSq,boxSub,boxAdd,boxNeg,

-both sides of the principal branch cut. -/

-    ∃ τ : ℂ, τ^3=T ∧ MemRectangle (centerBox (-1) 0 (1/1000000)) τ := by
-  obtain ⟨τ,ht,hb⟩ := refinedCubeCertificate_sound crossing_refined_certificate hT
-  refine ⟨τ,ht,?_⟩
-  norm_num [MemRectangle,boxMeet,centerBox] at hb ⊢
-  exact hb

-namespace Mub6.Classification.KarlssonCompiler
-open Complex Hadamard6 Mub6.Numerical Mub6.Numerical.IntervalKernel

-def omegaBox (rt : Interval) : RationalRectangle := boxAdd (boxPoint (-1/2) 0) (gammaBox rt)
-theorem omegaBox_sound {rt : Interval} (hr : sqrt3Valid rt) : MemRectangle (omegaBox rt) standardOmega := by
-  have h := mem_boxAdd (realPoint_mem (-1/2)) (gammaBox_sound hr)
-  have he : ((-1/2 : ℚ) : ℂ)+Complex.I*(Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ)/2=standardOmega := by
-    apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [standardOmega,Complex.div_re,Complex.div_im]
-  rwa [he] at h
-
-def fourierPublicBoxes (w p z : RationalRectangle) : Matrix I6 I6 RationalRectangle :=
-  let one := boxPoint 1 0
-  let negOne := boxPoint (-1) 0
-  let w2 := boxMul w w
-  Matrix.fromBlocks
-    !![one,one,one;one,negOne,p;one,one,w]
-    !![one,one,one;boxNeg p,z,boxNeg z;w,w2,w2]
-    !![one,negOne,boxMul w p;one,one,w2;one,negOne,boxMul w2 p]
-    !![boxNeg (boxMul w p),boxMul w2 z,boxNeg (boxMul w2 z);
-      w2,w,w;boxNeg (boxMul w2 p),boxMul w z,boxNeg (boxMul w z)]
-
-theorem fourierPublicBoxes_sound {w p z : RationalRectangle} {W P Z : ℂ}
-    (hw : MemRectangle w W) (hp : MemRectangle p P) (hz : MemRectangle z Z) :
-    ∀ i j, MemRectangle (fourierPublicBoxes w p z i j) (affineFourierMatrix W P Z i j) := by
-  have hww : MemRectangle (boxMul w w) (W^2) := by simpa only [pow_two] using mem_boxMul hw hw
-  have hnwp : MemRectangle (boxNeg (boxMul w p)) (-W*P) := by
-    simpa only [neg_mul] using mem_boxNeg (mem_boxMul hw hp)
-  have hone : MemRectangle (boxPoint 1 0) (1 : ℂ) := by simpa using realPoint_mem 1
-  have hn : MemRectangle (boxPoint (-1) 0) (-1 : ℂ) := by simpa using realPoint_mem (-1)
-  intro i j
-  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
-    dsimp only [fourierPublicBoxes,affineFourierMatrix]
-  all_goals first
-    | exact hone
-    | exact hn
-    | exact hp
-    | exact hz
-    | exact hw
-    | exact hww
-    | exact mem_boxNeg hp
-    | exact mem_boxNeg hz
-    | exact mem_boxMul hw hp
-    | exact mem_boxMul hw hz
-    | exact mem_boxMul hww hp
-    | exact mem_boxMul hww hz
-    | exact hnwp
-    | exact mem_boxNeg (mem_boxMul hww hp)
-    | exact mem_boxNeg (mem_boxMul hww hz)
-    | exact mem_boxNeg (mem_boxMul hw hz)
-
-structure SeamInput where
-  label : SeamLabel
-  parameters : Fin 2 → Interval
-  sqrt3 : Interval
-def SeamInput.omega (c : SeamInput) : RationalRectangle :=
-  let w := omegaBox c.sqrt3
-  if c.label.2.1 then boxMul w w else w
-def SeamInput.base (c : SeamInput) : Matrix I6 I6 RationalRectangle :=
-  fourierPublicBoxes c.omega
-    (clipUnit (circleBox c.label.2.2.1 (c.parameters 0)))
-    (clipUnit (circleBox c.label.2.2.2 (c.parameters 1)))
-def SeamInput.output (c : SeamInput) : CarrierRegion :=
-  clipCarrier (fun i j =>
-    if c.label.1 then c.base (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm j) (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm i)
-    else c.base (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm i) (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm j))
-
-theorem seam_compiler_sound (c : SeamInput) (hr : sqrt3Valid c.sqrt3) {x : Fin 2 → ℝ}
-    (hx : ∀ i, Mem (c.parameters i) (x i)) (hH : IsHadamard (seamMatrix c.label x)) :
-    CarrierBox c.output (ClassificationCover.toNumerical (seamMatrix c.label x)) := by
-  have hp := clipUnit_sound (circleBox_sound c.label.2.2.1 (hx 0)) (signedCircle_normSq _ _)
-  have hz := clipUnit_sound (circleBox_sound c.label.2.2.2 (hx 1)) (signedCircle_normSq _ _)
-  have hw : MemRectangle c.omega (if c.label.2.1 then standardOmega^2 else standardOmega) := by
-    dsimp only [SeamInput.omega]
-    split_ifs
-    · simpa only [pow_two] using mem_boxMul (omegaBox_sound hr) (omegaBox_sound hr)
-    · exact omegaBox_sound hr
-  have hb := fourierPublicBoxes_sound hw hp hz
-  apply clipCarrier_sound _ (ClassificationCover.numerical_of_public hH).1
-  intro i j
-  dsimp only [seamMatrix,seamChart,ClassificationCover.toNumerical,Matrix.submatrix,SeamInput.output]
-  split_ifs
-  · exact hb (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm j) (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm i)
-  · exact hb (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm i) (ClassificationCover.indexEquiv.symm j)
-
-#print axioms omegaBox_sound
-#print axioms fourierPublicBoxes_sound

-/-- Normalization only. No determinant threshold or reconstruction premise. -/
-def NormalizedCarrier (H : CompactCover.Mat6) : Prop :=
-  PhaseHadamard H ∧ (∀ j, H 0 j = 1) ∧ (∀ i, H i 0 = 1)
-
-/-- The leading corner maximizes R over every ordered positional corner.
-This predicate deliberately does not require good-side eligibility. -/
-def GlobalMax (H : CompactCover.Mat6) : Prop :=
-  NormalizedCarrier H ∧ ∀ p q : Perm, score (candidate H p q) ≤ score H
-
-theorem candidate_normalized {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : PhaseHadamard H)
-    (p q : Perm) : NormalizedCarrier (candidate H p q) :=
-  ⟨normalizeCarrier_PhaseHadamard (submatrix_hadamard hH p q),
-    normalizeCarrier_first_row (submatrix_hadamard hH p q),
-    normalizeCarrier_first_column (submatrix_hadamard hH p q)⟩
-
-/-- Finite maximization is on the full permutation domain, not the good subset. -/
-theorem global_representative {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : PhaseHadamard H) :
-    ∃ p q : Perm, GlobalMax (candidate H p q) := by
-  classical
-  obtain ⟨pq, _, hm⟩ := (Finset.univ : Finset (Perm × Perm)).exists_max_image
-    (fun pq => score (candidate H pq.1 pq.2)) (Finset.univ_nonempty)
-  refine ⟨pq.1, pq.2, candidate_normalized hH pq.1 pq.2, ?_⟩
-  intro r s
-  rw [candidate_comp hH]
-  exact hm (r.trans pq.1, s.trans pq.2) (Finset.mem_univ _)
-
-/-- The existing monomial quartet transport accompanies the new selection. -/
-theorem global_representative_occurs {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : PhaseHadamard H)
-    (ho : OccursAsQuartetEdge (normalizedNumerical H)) :
-    ∃ p q : Perm, GlobalMax (candidate H p q) ∧
-      OccursAsQuartetEdge (normalizedNumerical (candidate H p q)) := by
-  obtain ⟨p,q,hm⟩ := global_representative hH
-  exact ⟨p,q,hm,candidate_occurs hH ho p q⟩
-
-/-- In particular every one of the twenty-by-twenty increasing positional
-choices obeys the comparison required by the external all-400 domain. -/
-theorem globalMax_positional400 {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : GlobalMax H)
-    (r c : Fin 20) :
-    score (candidate H (columnPermutation r) (columnPermutation c)) ≤ score H :=
-  hH.2 _ _
-
-/-- Every physical carrier has a good corner with nonnegative R. Hence the
-maximum on the larger domain is nonnegative even without assuming eligibility. -/
-theorem globalMax_score_nonneg {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : GlobalMax H) :
-    0 ≤ score H := by
-  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := phaseHadamard_normalized_good_side_cover hH.1.1
-  exact le_trans (seed_radicand_nonneg hk)
-    (hH.2 (Equiv.refl _) (sidePermutation k))
-
-theorem globalMax_strict_or_zero {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : GlobalMax H) :
-    0 < score H ∨ score H = 0 := by
-  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (globalMax_score_nonneg hH) with h | h
-  · exact Or.inl h
-  · exact Or.inr h.symm

-/-- Full maximality together with separately established eligibility implies

-theorem globalMax_good {H : CompactCover.Mat6} (hH : GlobalMax H)
-    (hg : NormalizedGoodSideCarrier H) : CanonicalGood H :=

-    (hp : p.check b=true) {x : Fin 4 → ℝ} (hx : b.Contains x) :

-    (hH : Physical H) (hd : Dephased H) (hm : Maximal H) (hR : 0 < leadingR H)
-    (b : Box 4) (p : PhaseInput) (hp : p.check b=true)
-    (ht : rejectsBoth p.rectangles=true) {x : Fin 4 → ℝ}
-    (hx : b.Contains x)
-    (hphase : ∀ i : Fin 4, Complex.exp ((x i:ℂ)*Complex.I)=seedEntry H i) : False :=
-  phase_box_rejects_physical hH hd hm hR b p hp ht hx hphase

-strict physical population and its frontier is definitionally empty. -/

-    ∃ t : CertifiedTree StrictMaximalPopulation b,
-      t.frontier=[] ∧ ¬Live StrictMaximalPopulation b := by

-closed root or an actual maximal zero-R quartet. -/
